about.title: About
about.description: Moony is a personal wealth management application that helps you track your investments, savings, real estate, and more. Your data is stored in an encrypted database on this device. Only the tickers and currencies you track are sent to market-data services — see PRIVACY.md for the full list.

update.whatHappens: Moony downloads the new version and restarts; then you unlock it with your password again. Your data stays where it is.

export.noDataDescription: There is no data to export.

priceStatus.title: Price Data Status
priceStatus.description: Some prices may be outdated. This can happen when offline or due to API rate limits.
priceStatus.unknownRates: Excluded from totals: no exchange rate for {{currencies}}
priceStatus.staleRates: No current rate for {{currencies}} — values use the last rate from {{days}}+ days ago

fxQuality.missing: Not converted to {{currency}}: no exchange rate for {{currencies}}. Totals leave those positions out.
fxQuality.estimated: Some amounts use today's exchange rate because the rate of their day is not available yet.

errors.externalApi: A market-data service did not respond. Try again later.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside Moony. Check the logs for details.

boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.description: Moony ran into an unexpected problem and could not show this screen. Reloading usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, copy the details and add them to a bug report.

mcpTip.bankAccounts: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can create accounts and import transactions from a statement.
mcpTip.stocks: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can import trades from a broker statement.
mcpTip.crypto: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can import trades from an exchange export.
mcpTip.bonds: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can add bonds from a purchase confirmation.
mcpTip.loans: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can add a loan from the contract.
mcpTip.realEstate: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can add a property from its documents.
mcpTip.otherAssets: Don't feel like typing it all in? The AI assistant can add assets from an invoice or a list.
mcpTip.watchlist: The AI assistant can follow stocks for you — just tell it which ones.
mcpTip.body: Start the MCP server, give Claude the document or describe what you have, and ask it to add it for you. It shows you what it read and writes nothing until you confirm.

valuationHistory.title: Valuation history
valuationHistory.deleteDescription: The valuation of {{amount}} from {{date}} will be permanently removed. The market price follows the newest remaining valuation.

viewer.failed: The preview could not be shown. You can save the document or open it in another app.

openElsewhere.title: Open outside Moony?
openElsewhere.body: Moony creates a temporary unencrypted copy of the file so another app can open it. Moony deletes the copy when you lock or quit it, but it can't delete what the other app saves on its own.
